policy: Include all preparation, failed calls, retries and cache usage. Capture actual model, route, timestamps, result/usage and total cost from authentic CLI output. Missing usage/cost remains unknown with a reservation; do not record as zero. Stop the next call when cumulative actual plus unknown reservation approaches US$2. No automatic retry or unallocated JEV call. CLI --max-budget-usd for print is available; select cap only after common settings and remaining budget are confirmed.
